summary: Part of you wants one thing. Another part needs something else entirely.
body: Part of you wants one thing. Another part needs something else entirely. Your Sun square Moon keeps your will and your feelings in constant negotiation: restlessness, second-guessing, choosing a path and then mourning the one you didn't take. This isn't a flaw, it's friction. And friction is how you grow. Be patient with yourself.
gift: The ability to grow through inner friction instead of pretending every need points in the same direction.
shadow: Restlessness, second-guessing, and treating every choice as a loss of the path not taken.
integration: Let will and feeling negotiate without turning the negotiation into proof that something is wrong with you.
do: Name the want and the need separately
Give decisions enough time to settle
dont: Punish yourself for having mixed feelings
Make every choice prove the other path was wrong
Rush just to end the discomfort
